newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stocks & Stocks to detail unbundling in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Stocks & Stocks to detail unbundling in Jan.

text.p: South African construction to leisure group Stocks & Stocks Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday that it would detail the unbundling of its hotels and resorts operations later this month.
But a spokeswoman for the firm said the official announcement was likely to come at the end of January, not next Tuesday as local newspaper reports have suggested.
"It will come towards the end of the month," she said.
The firm is to hold a briefing with analysts and investors next Tuesday, but the spokeswoman said few concrete details of the unbundling would be discussed there.
"There won't be any discussion of the nitty gritty (of the listing)," she said.
Stocks & Stocks shares were unmoved at 400 cents at 1042 GMT in thin trade of only 2,000 shares.
